Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models (2210.11416v5) · paper method: The CoT mixture reuses nine prior datasets with human-written reasoning annotations and manually composed instruction templates; its ablation reports that omitting CoT data degrades performance on held-out CoT evaluations.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models (2210.11416v5) · paper method: The paper’s finetuning collection comprises 473 datasets, 146 task categories and 1,836 dataset/task-category tasks from Muffin, T0-SF, NIV2 and a CoT mixture; templates do not create separate tasks.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models (2210.11416v5) · paper method: At 540B parameters, Table 3 reports a normalized six-score held-out average of 49.1 without finetuning and 58.5 with all 1,836 tasks, a 9.4-point difference.

cohort3.claim.flan.scaled-evaluation

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported study; experiments, raw dataset records and formal proofs were not independently reproduced or verified.
  • The normalized macro-average is not raw overall accuracy. Section2.2 selects checkpoints using periodic evaluations of held-out tasks.
